user_profile.other_preferences: Need a stable job, Basic Coding experience, familiar with python, java,C++ languages and familiar with power BI,spring boot, dot net and tensorflow frameworks, already build some academic and personal projects, preferable language is python.

learning_plan.execution_strategy_summary: Alright, future Product/Marketing Data Analyst! This isn't just a curriculum; it's YOUR launchpad. We're leveraging every bit of your incredible CSE foundation – your core programming skills (Python, C++, Java), your exposure to frameworks like Spring Boot and .NET for data interaction, and even your TensorFlow familiarity – to fast-track you past the basics. Our strategy is laser-focused on ruthlessly prioritizing production-ready skills, building an unignorable portfolio from day one, and mastering the art of business communication. This ensures you transform into an irresistible candidate for those stable, impactful Product/Marketing Data Analyst roles within these crucial 3 months.

weekly_micro_goals: Week 1: Dive deep into Advanced SQL (Complex JOINs, Window Functions, CTEs). Establish your GitHub repo for your first portfolio project – think a real-world dataset, not Titanic! 🚀
Week 2: Conquer SQL Query Optimization (EXPLAIN ANALYZE) and advanced Date/Time/String functions. Start extracting and understanding the raw data for your chosen project.

Week 3: Master Pandas for DataFrames, advanced indexing, and efficient data loading/saving. Begin initial data cleaning and transformation for your project. Remember, your Python background gives you an unfair advantage here!
Week 4: Solidify Pandas GroupBy, Merging, Missing Data handling, and apply NumPy vectorized operations. Implement Git for robust version control on your evolving project, just like in a real team.
technical_skills_to_master: Advanced SQL: Window Functions, CTEs, Query Optimization for PostgreSQL (your Spring Boot/.NET database exposure means you'll pick this up fast!).
Python: Pandas DataFrames, NumPy for vectorized operations, robust data cleaning, merging, grouping.
Version Control: Git (staging, committing, branching) for professional project management.
interview_prep_goals: Solve 10-15 LeetCode Easy/Medium SQL problems, focusing on common analytical patterns (e.g., finding the Nth highest, running totals).
Practice explaining your SQL query logic step-by-step, as if to a non-technical manager.
Review basic Python data structures and algorithmic thinking – your CSE advantage here is huge for coding challenges!
what_you_will_build: Set up a GitHub repository for a compelling, end-to-end Product/Marketing Data Analyst portfolio project (e.g., 'Analyzing User Onboarding Funnel for a SaaS Product').
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract and pre-process initial raw data (use public datasets or simulate realistic ones) into a structured format.
Use Pandas to perform initial cleaning, transformation, and basic feature engineering on the extracted project data, building a clean dataset for analysis.
job_hunt_action_items: Optimize your LinkedIn profile: Update your headline and summary to clearly reflect your ambition for 'Product/Marketing Data Analyst' roles. Showcase relevant academic projects.
Begin researching target companies that align with your preferences and their typical data analyst tech stacks. Look for roles that value your CSE background.
monthly_plan.milestone_deliverable: A well-structured GitHub repository for your first portfolio project, with clean, version-controlled Python scripts and optimized SQL queries that extract and pre-process realistic data into a usable format, ready for deep analysis. This isn't just code; it's a story waiting to be told!

weekly_micro_goals: Week 1: Deep dive into Power BI Data Modeling (star schemas, relationships) and DAX for complex calculations. You already know Power BI, so let's unlock its advanced potential and apply it to your project! 📈
Week 2: Design effective Power BI dashboards with best practices (think user experience, clarity, and actionable insights). Build initial dashboards for your project's key metrics.
Week 3: Master Python visualization libraries (Seaborn for statistical plots, Matplotlib for customization). Create insightful static plots for project deep-dives that Power BI alone can't easily do.

Week 4: Grasp Hypothesis Testing (t-tests, Chi-squared) and A/B Testing Design (sample size, randomization). Apply these crucial statistical tests to findings within your project, using Python's `scipy.stats`.
technical_skills_to_master: Power BI: Advanced Data Modeling, DAX (Data Analysis Expressions), and dashboard design best practices (leveraging your existing familiarity for a huge head start!).
Python Visualization: Matplotlib, Seaborn for statistical plots and custom, publication-quality graphics.
Statistical Analysis: Hypothesis testing (t-tests, chi-squared), A/B testing design & interpretation, practical application with `scipy.stats` and `statsmodels` in Python.
interview_prep_goals: Practice explaining statistical concepts (p-value, confidence intervals, statistical significance) in simple, business-friendly terms.
Work through A/B testing case studies: design the experiment, analyze results, identify common pitfalls.
Prepare to discuss specific visualization choices and *why* they effectively communicate an insight.
what_you_will_build: A comprehensive Power BI dashboard for your project, featuring interactive visualizations and advanced DAX calculations to track key product/marketing metrics.
A Python script generating a series of static and potentially basic interactive (think Plotly/Dash concepts) visualizations for specific deep-dive analyses related to your project's user behavior.
Preliminary documentation of your project's statistical findings, including stated hypotheses, test results, and initial interpretations, building towards a data-driven conclusion.
job_hunt_action_items: Start tailoring your resume: Emphasize quantifiable project achievements and the specific tools you're mastering (SQL, Python, Power BI, Git). Use action verbs!
Connect with Data Analysts and Product/Marketing Managers on LinkedIn; begin reaching out for informational interviews if you feel confident.
monthly_plan.milestone_deliverable: A robust Power BI dashboard and a set of insightful Python visualizations, integrated into your ongoing portfolio project. This demonstrates both broad metric tracking and the ability to perform deep-dive statistical analysis, showcasing your dual technical and analytical prowess.

monthly_plan.theme: Business Impact, Storytelling & The Job Hunt Sprint
weekly_micro_goals: Week 1: Master Key Product & Marketing Metrics (LTV, CAC, Retention, Churn, Funnel Analysis, Attribution Models). Structure analytical narratives using the SCQA (Situation, Complication, Question, Answer) framework. Apply these directly to your project's insights.

Week 2: Refine your Data Storytelling, Presentation Skills, and how to craft impactful Executive Summaries. Practice presenting your project findings, focusing on business implications and actionable recommendations for a simulated audience. Your CSE logic helps you build a solid argument!

Week 3: Finalize 2-3 portfolio projects. Polish READMEs to perfection, ensuring each project clearly demonstrates end-to-end execution and business impact. Dive into intensive Mock Interview Practice (technical SQL/Python, behavioral STAR method, case studies).

Week 4: This is the sprint! Intensive Application Hustle, networking, cold outreach. Focus on refining your interview case study answers and articulating your unique value proposition, especially how your CSE background gives you an edge.
technical_skills_to_master: Product & Marketing Analytics: Key metrics (MAU/DAU, LTV, CAC), user segmentation, customer journey mapping, attribution models.
Data Storytelling & Business Communication: SCQA framework, tailoring communication for different audiences, crafting executive summaries, actionable recommendations.
Reinforcement: Seamlessly integrate SQL, Python, Power BI, and Statistical Analysis into cohesive, business-centric problem-solving.

Conceptual ML/API understanding: Understanding when and how ML model outputs (leveraging your TensorFlow/scikit-learn familiarity!) can inform analytical reporting, and conceptual understanding of APIs for data ingestion.
interview_prep_goals: Conduct at least 3 mock interviews (technical, behavioral, and presentation-based) with peers, mentors, or AI tools.
Practice articulating your portfolio projects with a sharp focus on the business problem, your approach, the insights found, and the *actionable impact*.
Refine your 'story' – why you're transitioning from a strong CSE background to Data Analysis, and why you are the ideal, uniquely qualified candidate for this specific role.
what_you_will_build: A compelling, data-driven presentation of your primary portfolio project, complete with executive summary, key findings, and actionable recommendations tailored for a business audience.
Two to three fully polished, end-to-end data analysis projects uploaded to GitHub, each with professional, engaging READMEs that tell a story and highlight your skills and impact.
A clear, concise narrative of how your CSE background (e.g., efficiency from Data Structures & Algorithms, structured problem-solving) provides a unique advantage in data analysis.
job_hunt_action_items: Apply to 10-15 relevant jobs per week, ensuring your resume and cover letter are meticulously tailored to each role and ATS-friendly!
Leverage LinkedIn for targeted networking, direct outreach to hiring managers, and engaging with company posts.
Prepare a crisp 'pitch' for why your blend of CSE rigor and new analytical skills makes you an indispensable asset to any data team.
monthly_plan.milestone_deliverable: A job-ready portfolio of 2-3 impactful, end-to-end data analysis projects, alongside a polished resume, optimized LinkedIn profile, and the confidence to ace interviews by articulating your skills, business impact, and unique background.

critical_guidelines: 💡 **The 70/30 Rule is Your Secret Weapon:** For every 30 minutes you spend reading or watching tutorials, commit a strict 70 minutes to hands-on coding, solving problems, or building your portfolio. This isn't optional; it's your anti-tutorial-hell shield! 🛡️

🛑 **Time-Box Your Struggles:** When you hit a bug or get stuck, set a timer for 30-45 minutes. If you haven't made progress, *step away* and ask for help (Stack Overflow, Discord communities, AI assistants). Don't let one obstacle derail your entire day! This is how you learn efficient debugging, a key industry skill.

🎯 **Projects Over Perfection – Iterate Early & Often:** Start building your portfolio projects immediately. They don't need to be perfect MVPs. Iteration is the core of real-world development! Avoid cliché projects; focus on real business problems. Your CSE background helps you understand the 'how' – now focus relentlessly on the 'what' and 'why' for business impact. 💪

🧠 **Embrace Your Buffer Hours:** Those 26 hours aren't just for emergencies; they're sacred time for deep dives on notoriously complex topics, mental breaks, or simply recharging. Treat them as essential. Burnout is a real job hunter's enemy, and we're going to avoid it! 🧘‍♀️

🗣️ **Communicate, Communicate, Communicate:** Practice articulating your thought process and findings *out loud* from day one. This isn't just about writing perfect SQL or Python; it's about translating data into clear, compelling, and actionable business decisions. Your ability to tell a powerful story with data will be your superpower in every interview. 🚀
learning_plan.final_readiness_summary: Congratulations! By completing this intensive roadmap, you won't just be 'another CSE graduate' applying for data analyst roles. You will emerge as a highly sought-after, production-ready Product/Marketing Data Analyst. Your strong analytical and problem-solving foundation from CSE, combined with expert-level SQL, efficient Python data manipulation, advanced Power BI dashboards (a skill you're already familiar with!), robust statistical analysis, and a keen eye for product/marketing metrics, sets you powerfully apart. You'll possess a compelling portfolio showcasing end-to-end problem-solving and, crucially, the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable business strategies. Recruiters will see a candidate who not only understands the technical 'how' but deeply grasps the business 'why' – a rare and invaluable combination for any team. You've got this!
